title: Welcome to Fluent Notes ✨
content:
Windows 11 Fluent Design edge-docked sticky notes!

[x] Hover over any edge tab to peek preview
[x] Click any tab to open rich-text editor
[ ] Drag dock up/down using top grip ::: handle
[ ] Discover shortcuts and customize colors!

title: Shortcuts & Hotkeys ⚡
content:
Boost your productivity with quick actions:

• Ctrl + Alt + N : Create new sticky note
• Ctrl + Alt + H : Tuck / Collapse dock to screen bezel
• Click [ ⇄ ] : Switch dock between Left & Right edges
• Double-click ::: grip handle to re-center vertically

title: Rich Text & Checklists 📝
content:
Everything you need for daily workflow:

[x] Rich text formatting: Bold, Italic, Lists
[x] Interactive task checklists with [ ] checkboxes
[ ] Vibrant Fluent pastel colors (Yellow, Blue, Mint, Lavender, Peach, Slate)
[ ] Fast search & tag filtering in dock header

title: 100% Local & Private 🔒
content:
Your notes never leave your computer:

• Fully offline desktop application
• Automatically saved locally in %APPDATA%\StickyNotes
• Zero tracking, zero telemetry, zero cloud lock-in
• Real-time backup protection
